lines: Father of love,
Hear our prayers.
Help us to know your will
And to do it with courage and faith.
Father of heaven and earth,
Hear our prayers,
And show us the way to peace in the world.
All-powerful and ever-living God,
Direct your love that is within us,
That our efforts in the name of your Son
May bring mankind to unity and peace.
Lord our God,
Help us to love you with all our hearts
And to love all men as you love them.
Father, watch over your family
And keep us safe in your care,
For all our hope is in you.
God our Father,
You have promised to remain for ever
With those who do what is just and right,
Help us to live in your presence.
Father,
Keep before us the wisdom and love
You have revealed in your Son,
Help us to be like Him
In word and deed, for he lives...
Lord, guide the course of world events
And give your Church the joy and peace
Of serving you in freedom.
Father, your love never fails,
Hear our call,
Keep us from danger
And provide for all our needs.
God of wisdom and love,
Source of all good,
Send your Spirit to teach us your truth
And guide our actions
In your way of peace.
Almighty God, our hope and our strength,
without you we falter.
Help us to follow Christ
and live according to your will.
Father,
guide and protect your people,
grant us an unfailing respect for your name,
and keep us always in your love.
Father, you call your children
to walk in the light of Christ.
Free us from darkness
and keep us in the radiance of your truth.
Father, through the obedience of Jesus,
your servant and your Son,
you raised a fallen world.
Free us from sin
and bring us the joy that lasts forever.
God, our Father, your light of truth
guides us to the way of Christ.
May all who follow him
reject what is contrary to the gospel.
Lord, be merciful to your people,
Fill us with your gifts
and make us always eager to serve you
in faith, hope, and love.
God our Father and protector,
without you nothing is holy,
nothing has value.
Guide us to everlasting life
by helping us to use wisely
the blessings you have given to the world.
Father of everlasting goodness,
our origin and guide,
be close to us and hear the prayers of all who praise you.
Forgive our sins and restore us to life.
Keep us safe in your love.
Almighty and ever living God,
your spirit made us your children,
confident to call you Father.
Increase your Spirit within us
and bring us to our promised inheritance.
God our Father,
may we love you in all things and above all things
and reach the joy you have prepared for us
beyond all our imagining.
Father, help us to seek the values
that will bring us lasting joy in this changing world.
in our desire for what you promise
make us one in mind and heart.
Almighty God,
every good thing comes from you
Fill our hearts with love for you
Increase our faith,
and by your constant care
protect the good you have given us.
God our Father, you redeem us,
and make us your children in Christ.
Look upon us,
give us true freedom
and bring us to the inheritance you
promised.
Almighty God our creator and guide,
may we serve you with all our hearts
and know your forgiveness in our lives.
Father, guide us, as you guide creation
according to your law and love.
May we love one another
and come to perfection in the eternal life prepared for us.
Father you show your almighty power
in your mercy and forgiveness.
Continue to fill us with your gifts of love.
Help us to hurry towards the eternal life you promise
and come to share in the joys of your kingdom.
Father, your love for us
surpasses all our hopes and desires.
Forgive our failings,
keep us in your peace and lead us in the way of salvation.
Lord, our help and guide,
make your love the foundation of our lives.
May our love for you express itself
in our eagerness to do good for others.
Almighty and ever living God,
our source of power and inspiration,
give us strength and joy
in serving you as followers of Christ,
who lives and reigns...
Almighty and ever living God,
strengthen our faith, hope, and love.
May we do with loving hearts what you ask of us
and come to share the life you promise.
God of power and mercy, only with your help
can we offer you fitting service and praise.
May we live the faith we profess
and trust your promise of eternal life.
God of power and mercy,
protect us from all harm,
give us freedom of spirit
and health in mind and body
to do your work on earth.
Father of all that is good,
keep us faithful in serving you,
for to serve you is our lasting joy.
Lord, increase our eagerness to do your will
and help us to know the saving power of your love.
